name: Select With Search
description: Provides a field widget that renders a select list with a searchable/filterable dropdown and label.
project_description:
SelectWithSearch intends to add search option on select field.

 FEATURES

--------

Module will add new widget called "Select With Search".

Applicable on single selection Select Filed only.

 REQUIREMENTS

------------

 No special requirements.

 CREDIT

-------

Module is using downloaded version of JS and CSS of "Select2 4.0.1" Jquery Library. 

 LIMITATION

-----------

Module is designed to handle "Allowed number of values : 1" under "Field Settings".

 Removed Limitation of : Module is designed to handle "Allowed number of values : 1" under "Field Settings". Now unlimited option has been added with version 1.0.2

 CONFIGURATION

-------------

 * Configure the SelectWithSearch at (/admin/structure/types/manage//form-display).
